data.why: The repo ships a valid sand/silt/clay/BD example CSV for the golden path; a second CSV with differently-named columns, a missing value, and a row that fails the sum-to-100 check exercises column mapping and the app's validation error path.

goals: Upload a CSV of sand/silt/clay percentages for a set of soil samples and preview the data to confirm it loaded correctly
Map arbitrary column names in my lab's export onto sand, silt, and clay so the app can interpret it
Classify each sample into USDA soil texture classes and see where samples fall on the ternary diagram
Switch to the HYPRES classification system to compare class boundaries against USDA for the same samples
Size points by an auxiliary measurement (e.g. bulk density) to look for a relationship with texture class
Download the classified CSV with the added texture_class column for use in downstream analysis

review.summary: The tree captures this small app well: the goal, the four phases and the core tasks (upload, map, classify under USDA or HYPRES, size by an auxiliary column, export) match the README and streamlit_app.py, and the evidence holds up in nearly every screen I opened. Before filing, it needs light trimming: three framework-chrome tasks should be demoted, f5's toolbar items removed, and the download evidence replaced.
